subject: Post-discovery follow-up — 30m intro demo & ops/security attendees
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Cole <andrew.cole@heliohealth.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery follow-up — 30m intro demo & ops/security attendees

Thanks again for the conversation today — great to hear more about Helio Health's roadmap for automated clinical summarization. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary goal is to reduce clinician note time and improve documentation consistency. Key constraints: PHI handling (on-prem option), <5s per-request latency target for triage flows, and strict retention controls.
- Next step: 30-minute product intro (high level + short tech Q&A) for the broader stakeholder group (product, infra/security, clinical ops).

I can propose the following 30-minute windows (all PT):
  1) Tue Jun 22 — 09:00–09:30 PT
  2) Wed Jun 23 — 13:00–13:30 PT
  3) Thu Jun 24 — 11:30–12:00 PT

Please let me know which of these works for you and which Helio attendees you'd like to include (suggest product owner, security/compliance lead, and an SRE or infra owner). We can tighten to two options if that helps calendars.

I've attached a short discovery notes PDF and an initial MVP scope doc to help folks prep. Also attaching a one-page pre-demo checklist (simple ops/security items we typically confirm ahead of an intro).

Attachments: discovery-notes-helio.pdf (summary), MVP-scope-helio.docx, pre-demo-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to move a slot and send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

—
Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Andrew — Rishi here (SE on the call). Quick note on attendee expectations and a slightly adjusted slot set that may be easier for our engineering folks to support (we prefer to avoid weekend prep).

If Helio will have security/compliance in the room, it helps if your SRE or infra lead can attend for the 10–12 minute technical Q&A at the end. For the overview we typically keep it high-level (20 min product + 10 min tech).

Alternate slots (PT) we can guarantee full SE attendance for: 
  • Tue Jun 22 — 08:30–09:00 PT (I can be on at 08:15 for quick sync)
  • Wed Jun 23 — 13:00–13:30 PT

I also attached a one-page pre-demo checklist for ops/security so your lead can scan ahead of time. If 08:30 on the 22nd works for your security lead, that gives us the best overlap.

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf

Thanks — cc'ing Mina and Jordan to keep calendars tight.
